scripts.cap:sync: vite build && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: vite build && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug && cd .. && powershell -Command "Copy-Item android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk -Destination AspireLearning.apk -Force; Copy-Item android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk -Destination AspireLearning-debug.apk -Force; Copy-Item android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk -Destination public/AspireLearning.apk -Force"
scripts.bundle:release: vite build && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease && cd .. && powershell -Command "Copy-Item android/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab -Destination AspireLearning-release.aab -Force"
